candidate_profile.compatibility: Not live-tested. Server DTO sources checked at v3.0.109; exact older mc madmin parse-config source could not be retrieved. Its schema is a candidate requiring real pinned-mc compatibility verification.

implemented_connection: CheckCurrent reopens independently SHA-pinned startup source, verifies external Ed25519 original grant/current head/configuration observation from exact current ConfigMap UID/RV and namespace UID, then intersects original SQL/config/KEK and credential windows.

Five distinct original credential access-key hashes map to the exact original config identity/ref-version, separate from the dedicated sixth observer account. No caller Passed/proof DTO or SDK existence grants permission.

HTTPS native GETs use normal SigV4, verified CA and exact leaf SPKI; redirects, unknown version/commit, missing/incomplete/oversized responses, unexpected pagination and expired credentials refuse. One named built-in policy, enabled regular user, no group inheritance, exact closed action/resource subset; Deny/conditions/unknown policy forms refuse the entire result.
Native ServerInfo, named GetUserInfo and InfoCannedPolicyV2 plus both buckets' policy absence and versioning are collected twice. No object PUT/DELETE, policy writes, account creation or login probe.

Actual Kubernetes Deployment/ReplicaSet/Pod/ServiceAccount/Node/Service owner chain and bounded complete EndpointSlice pagination are read twice. Current owner records, credentials and SQL identity/time are re-read at the tail.

ObserveMinIOOriginalOwnerConfiguration runs the independently binary-pinned official mc with the original owner's already existing private config-v10 alias. It verifies the alias account/HTTPS endpoint, existing CA file, actual candidate ServerInfo, mc version, and six complete all-target configuration responses including envOverride; repeats all reads and pins; never creates aliases, writes config or installs rights.

The original owner's existing separately mounted private Ed25519 key can sign only the actual configuration-observation record produced by those reads. It is not generated, exposed to the controller, or used to sign a grant/head. The record explicitly has no UsersSystem/disabled-plugin/permission-success assertion. It is returned with the runtime-oracle error, not as ready evidence.

precise_remaining_gap.reason: Reviewed named-user/policy and reporting-config APIs do not supply an authenticated complete effective/runtime authorization oracle. Current config values and an original owner's signature do not by themselves establish the running plugin/OPA/identity state, reload/activation state, or all effective permission paths. A successful local JSON/TLS fixture cannot establish this native compatibility or exclusion.
precise_remaining_gap.current_behavior: Even after all actual source reads, CheckCurrent returns partial private observation plus this error. CheckPublicationDependenciesWithMinIO propagates the error and cannot return success. No runtime source implementation, always-ready alternate, publication-loop hookup or complete five-role permission producer is claimed.
precise_remaining_gap.required_next_source: A version-pinned authenticated native runtime/effective-permission source (or a separately reviewed source-level closed-profile proof bound to actual process/runtime configuration and reload generation), with complete plugin/group/STS/service-account/parent-policy exclusion and current revocation. Do not replace it with signed booleans, mock JSON, owner statements or capability shape validation.
additional_compatibility_gaps: Exact selected mc/madmin parser compatibility needs original pinned binary execution evidence.

Official mc verifies TLS CA but this wrapper does not inject its own SPKI check into mc's individual encrypted GET TLS connections; native observer checks SPKI before/after. This must not be represented as an atomic per-request mc SPKI proof.

Only the narrow closed policy subset is supported. Any extra rights, conditions, group mappings, temporary/service credentials, fork, other server version, separate provider endpoint or incomplete source refuses.

installation_inputs_still_required: Read-only preflight must first establish the actual MinIO version/commit, API transport compatibility and resource identity. Unknown/mismatched version is refused, not auto-migrated to the candidate profile.

Independent startup source file/hash, external original owner public issuer, namespace UID, epoch floor, exact grant/head/configuration-observation ConfigMap names and UIDs, and grant hash. Original owner installs/updates/revokes the actual records; reader does not self-enroll or choose pins from imported data.

Original owner grant must bind actual config SHA, TLS CA/SPKI, deployment ID, Deployment/RS/Pod/SA/Node/Service UID chain, exact image/container and all five distinct source ref/account/policy hashes with original windows.

Dedicated regular observer account already installed with admin:GetUser, admin:GetPolicy, admin:ServerInfo on *, and s3:GetBucketPolicy/s3:GetBucketVersioning only on the exact two buckets. Do not add admin:ConfigUpdate to this observer.

Original configuration owner separately holds its existing ConfigUpdate authority, original account alias, private config-v10 file/hash, pinned official mc binary/hash, existing configDir/certs/CAs certificate matching actual CA hash, original short window, and separately pinned existing owner signing key/public issuer. Only the independently authorized owner process may call the producer; no controller private-key mount or authority bootstrap is implemented.

Original target/catalog file refs, actual five independent credentials with original lifetimes, existing SQL active-config/KEK/publisher sources and owner-source RBAC. Existing C5/A deployment checks may transitively perform existing SQL binding operations; do not describe the whole call as guaranteed zero-write SQL.

Complete native runtime/effective source above must be implemented and reviewed before any ordinary publication readiness or success claim. All original publication, readback, task purpose and non-DR gates remain required.
